name: Stop
meaning: Stop and give way — you MUST stop behind the line.

name: Give way
meaning: Give way to traffic on the major road.

name: No entry
meaning: No entry for vehicular traffic.

name: No motor vehicles
meaning: No motor vehicles permitted.

name: No overtaking
meaning: No overtaking until the restriction ends.

name: No U-turns
meaning: U-turns prohibited.

name: No right turn
meaning: Right turn prohibited.

name: No left turn
meaning: Left turn prohibited.

name: No vehicles
meaning: No vehicles except bicycles being pushed.

name: No cycling
meaning: Riding of pedal cycles prohibited.

name: Clearway — no stopping
meaning: No stopping at any time on the main carriageway (clearway).

name: No waiting
meaning: Waiting restrictions apply (see plate for times).

name: Give priority to oncoming vehicles
meaning: Give way to vehicles from the opposite direction.

name: Turn left ahead
meaning: Turn left ahead (mandatory direction).

name: Ahead only
meaning: Ahead only (mandatory direction).

name: Keep left
meaning: Keep to the left of the obstruction.

name: Mini-roundabout
meaning: Mini-roundabout — give way to traffic from the immediate right.

name: Route for buses and cycles only
meaning: Lane reserved for use by buses and pedal cycles only.

name: Contraflow bus lane
meaning: A bus lane running against the normal direction of traffic.

name: With-flow pedal cycle lane
meaning: Mandatory cycle lane in the same direction as traffic.

name: Minimum speed 30
meaning: Minimum speed limit of 30 mph applies.

name: End of minimum speed
meaning: End of the minimum speed requirement.

name: No vehicles over height shown
meaning: No vehicles exceeding the height shown on the sign.

name: No vehicles over width shown
meaning: No vehicles exceeding the width shown on the sign.

name: No goods vehicles over weight
meaning: No goods vehicles over the maximum gross weight shown.

name: School crossing patrol
meaning: Stop when signalled to do so by a school crossing patrol.

name: National speed limit applies
meaning: The national speed limit for the road and vehicle type applies.

name: Entry to 20 mph zone
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 20 mph applies in the zone.

name: Maximum speed 30
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 30 mph.

name: Maximum speed 40
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 40 mph.

name: Maximum speed 50
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 50 mph.

name: Crossroads
meaning: Crossroads ahead.

name: T-junction with priority over vehicles from the right
meaning: T-junction ahead; the broader line indicates priority through route.

name: Staggered junction
meaning: Staggered junction ahead.

name: Bend to right
meaning: Bend to the right ahead (or left if symbol reversed).

name: Double bend first to left
meaning: Double bend ahead, first to the left (or right if symbol reversed).

name: Roundabout
meaning: Roundabout ahead.

name: Uneven road
meaning: Uneven road surface ahead.

name: Slippery road
meaning: Slippery road surface ahead.

name: Road narrows on both sides
meaning: The road narrows on both sides ahead.

name: Road narrows on right
meaning: The road narrows on the right ahead (or left if symbol reversed).

name: Two-way traffic straight ahead
meaning: Two-way traffic straight ahead.

name: Two-way traffic crosses one-way road
meaning: Two-way traffic crosses a one-way road ahead.

name: Traffic signals
meaning: Traffic signals ahead.

name: Traffic signals not in use
meaning: Traffic signals ahead are not in use.

name: Zebra crossing
meaning: Zebra crossing ahead.

name: Pedestrians in road ahead
meaning: Pedestrians likely to be in the road ahead (no footway).

name: School children crossing
meaning: Children going to or from school or a playground ahead.

name: Frail or disabled pedestrians
meaning: Frail (elderly or disabled) pedestrians likely to cross the road ahead.

name: Cycle route ahead
meaning: Cycle route ahead.

name: Cattle
meaning: Cattle likely to be in the road ahead.

name: Wild animals
meaning: Wild animals likely to be in the road ahead.

name: Wild horses or ponies
meaning: Wild horses or ponies likely to be in the road ahead.

name: Accompanied horses or ponies
meaning: Accompanied horses or ponies likely to be in the road ahead.

name: Steep hill downwards
meaning: Steep downhill gradient ahead (gradient shown as a percentage).

name: Steep hill upwards
meaning: Steep uphill gradient ahead (gradient shown as a percentage).

name: Hump bridge
meaning: Hump bridge ahead.

name: Tunnel ahead
meaning: Tunnel ahead.

name: Level crossing with barrier or gate
meaning: Level crossing with barrier or gate ahead.

name: Level crossing without barrier
meaning: Level crossing without barrier or gate ahead.

name: Trams crossing ahead
meaning: Trams crossing the road ahead.

name: Falling or fallen rocks
meaning: Risk of falling or fallen rocks ahead.

name: Side winds
meaning: Risk of strong side winds ahead.

name: Quayside or river bank
meaning: Quayside or river bank ahead — risk of vehicle entering water.

name: Soft verges
meaning: Soft verges ahead — risk of grounding.

name: Risk of ice
meaning: Risk of ice or packed snow on the road ahead.

name: Traffic queues likely ahead
meaning: Queuing traffic likely on the road ahead.

name: Road humps
meaning: Road humps for the distance shown.

name: Low-flying aircraft
meaning: Low-flying aircraft or sudden aircraft noise ahead.

name: Overhead electric cable
meaning: Overhead electric cable ahead — maximum safe height shown.

name: Dual carriageway ends
meaning: Dual carriageway ends ahead.

name: Ford
meaning: Worded warning sign — water crosses the road ahead.

name: One-way traffic
meaning: One-way traffic — vehicles must travel in the direction shown.

name: Priority over oncoming vehicles
meaning: Traffic on this side has priority over oncoming vehicles.

name: No through road
meaning: Road ahead is a dead end for vehicles.

name: Parking place
meaning: Direction to a parking place.

name: Hospital ahead with A&E
meaning: Hospital ahead with Accident and Emergency facilities.

name: Tourist information point
meaning: Direction to a tourist information point.

name: Area with traffic enforcement cameras
meaning: Area in which cameras are used to enforce traffic regulations.

name: End of bus lane
meaning: End of bus lane.

name: Recommended route for pedal cycles
meaning: Recommended route for pedal cycles.

name: Emergency diversion route
meaning: Symbol indicating an emergency diversion route for motorway traffic.

name: Start of motorway
meaning: Start of motorway and point from which motorway regulations apply.

name: End of motorway
meaning: End of motorway — motorway regulations no longer apply.

name: Countdown markers (motorway)
meaning: Countdown markers at exit from motorway: each bar represents 100 yards to the exit.

name: Primary route direction
meaning: Green-backed signs indicate primary routes between places of traffic importance.

name: Non-primary route direction
meaning: White-backed signs with black borders indicate non-primary routes.

name: Ring road
meaning: Direction to a ring road.

name: Road works
meaning: Road works ahead.

name: Loose chippings
meaning: Loose chippings on the road — reduce speed.

name: Lane closed ahead
meaning: One lane closed ahead at road works.

name: End of road works
meaning: End of road works and any temporary restrictions.

name: Contraflow
meaning: Lane crossover at contraflow road works.

name: Slow — wet tar
meaning: Temporary hazard: wet tar on the road surface.

name: Stop line at signals or police control
meaning: Solid white stop line — stop when required by signals or police.

name: Give way to traffic on major road
meaning: Double broken white lines across the road — give way.

name: Box junction
meaning: Yellow criss-cross lines — do not enter unless your exit is clear.

name: Keep clear
meaning: Do not block this part of the road.

name: Zig-zag lines
meaning: No stopping at any time within the area marked by zig-zag lines.

name: Double yellow lines
meaning: No waiting at any time.

name: Red route — double red lines
meaning: No stopping at any time on a red route.

name: Hazard warning line
meaning: Longer centre-line markings with shorter gaps warn of a hazard ahead.

name: Chevrons bordered by solid line
meaning: Area you MUST NOT enter except in an emergency.
